name: squeeze_floor_no_widening_floor_gt_presqueeze
description: AC-2 no-widening invariant: the floor (0.30) EXCEEDS the pre-squeeze distance (0.15). A naive max(squeezed, floor) would WIDEN the stop to 0.30 -- above its pre-squeeze value -- inverting the squeeze into a widener. The correct min(floor, pre_squeeze) bound caps the clamp AT pre_squeeze (0.15). This is the single most important adversarial fixture: it proves the floor limits SHRINKAGE only.
derivation: safe_vol=0.15. raw=0.15*1.0=0.15. pre_squeeze=max(0.15,0.10)=0.15. para_armed -> active=0.15*0.5=0.075. squeeze_floor=0.30 > pre_squeeze 0.15, so min(0.30,0.15)=0.15; clamp=max(0.075,0.15)=0.15. Output 0.15 == pre_squeeze, NEVER 0.30. A naive max(0.075,0.30)=0.30 impl (widening the stop above pre-squeeze) FAILS here.
